checks.criterion: CSV campaign setup accepts a CSV upload and allows flexible mapping of recipient, identity, initial subject/body, and follow-up subject/body columns
checks.name: csv-wizard-column-mapping
checks.evidence: Uploaded /app/tests/fixtures/personalized-leads.csv, mapping-step auto-mapped Email/First Name/Company + all 3 sequence subject/body columns, then map-company-column and map-initial-subject selects were changed to a different column and reverted, proving no fixed column names are assumed.

checks.criterion: The CSV is the source of truth and each lead's copy remains independent
checks.name: csv-wizard-preview-per-lead-and-skip
checks.evidence: Preview step showed John's card with exact subject 'Quick idea for ABC security' and body containing 'This exact message belongs only to John.', Sarah's card with distinct subject 'Security compliance at XYZ' and her own body text; asserted John's subject != Sarah's subject and no cross-row text bleed.

checks.criterion: Incomplete personalized rows are not sent
checks.name: csv-wizard-preview-per-lead-and-skip
checks.evidence: Same preview run: summary card showed valid_count=2, and the Missing/Incomplete lead card (missing.csv-test@example.com) displayed a 'Skipped: Missing ...' badge because First Subject was empty.

checks.criterion: The CSV is the source of truth / incomplete rows skipped (API layer)
checks.name: test_tscheck_csv_preview_personalization.py::test_preview_keeps_exact_per_lead_copy_and_skips_incomplete_row
checks.evidence: POST /api/csv/campaigns/preview with the fixture CSV returned valid_count=2, skipped_count=1; John/Sarah step subjects and bodies matched their own CSV rows exactly and differed from each other; missing lead's error mentioned 'subject'.

checks.criterion: Campaigns support multiple connected inboxes, per-inbox daily limits, and controlled spacing
checks.name: csv-wizard-multi-inbox-selection
checks.evidence: Inbox-selection step listed both real connected Gmail inboxes (deepanshu@rohence.com, deepanshu@tryrohence.com) each showing 'NN / day', both were checked simultaneously, and selection persisted through Next/Back navigation.

checks.criterion: Campaigns support multiple connected inboxes, per-inbox daily limits, and controlled spacing (spacing/distribution)
checks.name: test_tscheck_csv_multi_inbox_spacing.py::test_launch_distributes_leads_across_inboxes_with_spaced_repeat_sends
checks.evidence: POST /api/csv/campaigns then /launch (day_offset=1, future) with 4 leads across 2 inboxes: activity split 2/2 across both inbox ids, and consecutive scheduled_at times for the same inbox+step were 10-20 minutes apart (verified via GET /api/csv/campaigns/{id}/activity).

checks.criterion: Sequence days, exact start times, and timezone are configurable
checks.name: csv-wizard-sequence-timing
checks.evidence: Changed timezone to America/New_York, day offsets to 2/5/9 and send times to 08:15/13:30/16:45 for Initial/Follow-up 1/Follow-up 2; values carried into the preview step and remained set after navigating back.

checks.criterion: Sequence days, exact start times, and timezone are configurable (scheduling accuracy)
checks.name: test_tscheck_csv_sequence_timezone.py::test_launch_schedules_using_configured_day_time_and_timezone
checks.evidence: Campaign with day_offset=3, send_time=15:45, timezone=America/New_York launched; GET activity's scheduled_at converted to America/New_York matched the expected date/hour/minute exactly.

checks.criterion: Campaign dashboard supports operation and lead-level auditing
checks.name: csv-dashboard-campaign-audit
checks.evidence: New CSV campaign row showed total leads (2) and 'running' status; pause->paused, resume->running, and stop->stopped controls all updated the status badge; opening the row showed the lead activity drawer with per-lead timeline and a download-campaign-status-link pointing to /api/csv/campaigns/{id}/export.

checks.criterion: Campaign dashboard supports operation and lead-level auditing (metrics/export API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_csv_dashboard_lifecycle.py::test_dashboard_metrics_pause_resume_stop_and_export
checks.evidence: GET /api/csv/campaigns listing showed total_leads=1, emails_scheduled=1, sent/failed/skipped=0; PATCH status paused/running/stopped worked; stop cancelled the scheduled activity row; GET /export returned text/csv containing the campaign id and 'Mailflow Status' column.

checks.criterion: Inbox/template/recipient deletion and workspace settings are usable
checks.name: workspace-settings-and-deletion-safety
checks.evidence: Settings view saved sending defaults; created inbox edited via display name/signature/daily limit (33/day) then deleted after confirmation; unused template and recipient deleted after confirmation; a freshly-created inbox referenced by a legacy campaign showed the blocking error 'Inbox is used by an existing campaign' instead of deleting.

checks.criterion: Deepanshu naming and navigation are updated
checks.name: core-navigation-naming
checks.evidence: Dashboard title read 'Good morning, Deepanshu', avatar showed 'DS', and nav buttons Dashboard/Campaigns/Leads/Inboxes/CSV imports/Legacy templates/Activity plus Workspace settings were all visible and clickable.
